args.code: the worked notebook's definitions and reference solutions, run in-process

note: What every seat's lab computes at the live budget, for seats 0-99 (seeds (seat + 1) * 1000 + i). per_seed['summary'] is indexed like `seeds` (the seat numbers): each seat's verdicts at 1000, 5000 and 20 000 rounds, IQMs, the x 10 outcome, the room-code scalars (including ucb1_x10_lower and ucb1_late_lead) and the epsilon sweep's IQMs. per_seed['seat_0'] also holds seat 0's per-seed values ('raw'): epsilon-greedy and UCB1 as [regret at 1000, 5000, 20000] (the 20 000-round runs continue the 5000-round runs exactly), Thompson sampling as [1000, 5000], the rest at 5000. Everything is computed from the unrounded values with the lab's verdict and prl.evaluate. 8 worker processes. Wall time on local (Apple M1 Pro, arm64): a laptop time, not a Colab time. One-minute load average 4 at the start and 13 at the end: other builds were running on this machine, so the time is inflated.
